age_seconds.description: Age of the data at response time

as_of.description: When the data was read from the ledger

ledger_index.description: Validated ledger the data comes from

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

balance.description: Positive: the peer owes the account; negative: the account owes

currency.description: Canonical currency code (3 characters or 40 hex)

currency_ascii.description: Readable text of a 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

deep_freeze.description: True when the account has deep-frozen the line

deep_freeze_peer.description: True when the peer has deep-frozen the line

headroom.description: Holder only: limit minus balance; null for an issuer

role.description: `issuer` when the balance is negative, else `holder`

marker.description: Opaque cursor for the next page (send as `marker`); null on the last page

description: One page of an account's trust lines, with an opaque cursor for the next page. When to use: To list every trust line of an account (balances, limits, freeze and authorization flags), page by page. Prefer another tool: For a quick capped overview with the XRP balance, use `/v1/xrpl/account/{address}/summary`; for issued totals of a token, use the token endpoint. Example: xrpl_account_lines {"address":"rvYAfWj5gh67oV6fW32ZzP3Aw4Eubs59B"} Paid: 0.01452 USDC or 0.0121 EURC per call on Solana mainnet, VAT included. With prepaid credits, debit per call: 0.0025 EUR-denominated units (approx 400 calls per bundle) or 0.003 USD-denominated units (approx 273 calls per bundle).

address.description: Valid classic XRPL account address (r..., checksum verified)

limit.description: Lines per page: an integer from 10 to 400 (default 100)

marker.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's `marker`, for the same address

peer.description: Only lines with this counterparty (classic address)

name: xrpl_account_lines
